name: Default
shortDescription: Open source kanban boards with swimlanes, checklists and attachments, backed by FerretDB on embedded SQLite.

alerts.message: The first account registered becomes the administrator. Sign up right after deploying, then turn off self-registration in Admin Panel / People / Login if the board should be invite-only.

Invitations, password resets and notifications need SMTP: configure it in Admin Panel / People / E-mail, or set MAIL_URL (for example smtp://user:pass@mail.example.com:587/) and MAIL_FROM. Without it, emails are only written to the container log.
